comments: Information of tracklisting from Hal C F Astell's website.
Lie Back And Enjoy It (tracks 15-17) from Piet Corbijn.
Tommy mentions that Hawkwind will be doing a session for the show soon.

Date confirmed by Tommy at the end of the show, by wishing Alan Freeman (then on Capital Radio domestically, but also by this point a colleague of Vance at BFBS) a happy birthday for 45 seconds time; he was born on 6 July.
